label: needs something from earlier?
instructions: Does {name}'s next line need something said earlier, in this conversation or a past one with {name}, that isn't in quoted_recent or quoted_latest?
true: Yes: the line being answered refers back to something said before and not shown here ('remember what I told you about…', 'what was her name again?', 'like you said last time'), or answering it well needs a detail from that earlier talk.
false: No: what the line needs is in the lines shown, or it starts something new.

true: What did I say my sister's name was?
Did you ever try the cake I told you about?

state_note: memory D26: asked per candidate (earlier:{characterId}) only when the session has indexed lines or the candidate has an overflow; rides every plan beside docs, with the same state fields. t_gate 0.4 is its own value, tuned in phase 10.
